items.stem: Distinguish between 'footloose labour' and 'circulation of labour'.
items.answer: Footloose labour: Jan Breman's term for migrant workers who move from place to place in search of work. Circulation of labour: the seasonal movement of agricultural labourers between their villages and areas where work is available.
